description: A stunning coastal infinity pool terrace photographed at sunset with a low, wide lens perspective. The pool occupies the right portion of the frame, its still turquoise-blue water perfectly reflecting the dramatic pink, lavender, and peach sunset sky above. The far horizon reveals open ocean water meeting the sky, with a dark shoreline tree line and the silhouette of a tall conifer tree rising above the hedge. On the right, a clean-lined dark metal pergola structure partially frames a modern grey chaise lounge. The pool deck is a combination of grey composite or dark weathered hardwood decking running along the left edge and warm light limestone or travertine pavers along the pool coping. The horizontal composition captures the long sweep of the pool edge and deck at a low seated-to-ground camera angle. Cylindrical low-profile bollard-style glowing forms are placed at intervals along the pool deck edge and coping, emitting soft warm white ambient glows that pool at ground level and reflect subtly off the nearby water surface. Their warm illumination contrasts with the cool blue of the pool and the purple-pink sky. Camera is at low standing or seated eye-level, shooting with a wide lens in an off-center thirds composition, looking across the pool from left to right with a slight upward pitch toward the sunset horizon. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
